owner: <the person who decides what is reserved: a name or a role>

product.idPattern: <a regular expression for a requirement id, e.g. REQ-\d+>

design.cite: by file and section, rule or endpoint

commands.tests: <the full test command, required at delivery/release checkpoints>
commands.ci: <the project's CI command, e.g. node scripts/ci.mjs>
commands.scaffold: <the skeleton generator, or empty until there is one: factory/harness/interfaces.md>
commands.contracts: <the contract tests and integration run, or empty: factory/harness/interfaces.md>

ciPattern: <a regular expression that matches the CI command, e.g. scripts/ci\.mjs>

vendors.b: <e.g. Codex, or the same vendor in a fresh context>

code: <the folders of hand-written code, e.g. src/>

services.name: <a service every lane needs, e.g. the container engine>
services.check: <a command that answers when it is up>
services.restart: <the steps, in order, that only the super runs>
